text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is upon us once more this 
year. Eager to witness history just like 
last year, racing fans from all over the 
country have gathered—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Another star-studded lineup! I'm super 
hyped! Maybe we'll witness a new legend 
being born...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate showdown between peers of the 
Tiara line, huh? It looks like it's gonna 
be an incredible race, just like last 
year...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Just what kind of race will this turn 
out to be?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Looking forward to it, Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —...All right, Trainer, if you would.
choice_data_list:
Leave it to me. I'll be the most 
eye-catching one in the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, why are you heading into the 
paddock?! You're not an Umamusume!
choice_data_list: 任せて。パドックで一番目立ってくる！
choice_data_list_en: Leave it to me. I'll be the one turning heads in the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Okaaay. Thanks for cheering so loudly~
choice_data_list: 今日も頑張れ～！ラッキーライラック～！！
choice_data_list_en: Give it your all today too~! Lucky Lilac~!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you're not even a fan!! Did you 
forget what your actual job is!?
choice_data_list: Ah, I remember now! I'm a Trainer...!
Ah, I remember now! I'm a Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You really had amnesia!? Wait, does that 
mean you forgot about me too—
choice_data_list: はっ、思い出した！俺はトレーナーだ……！
はっ、思い出した！私はトレーナーだ……！
choice_data_list_en: Ha, I remember now! I'm a Trainer...!
Ha, I remember now! I'm a Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Look, as expected, you forgo—
choice_data_list: 覚えているよ！女王ラッキーライラックだ！
choice_data_list_en: I remember! It's Queen Lucky Lilac!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You're NOT gonna do it?!! You're not gonna 
play the straight man there?!
choice_data_list:
Even if I go senile, I could never forget 
you.

Even if I go senile, I could never forget 
you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, my, aren't you quite the smooth 
talker! Enough already!
choice_data_list: ボケたくても君は忘れられないよ
ボケたくても貴方は忘れられないよ
choice_data_list_en: Even if my mind goes, I could never forget you.
Even if my mind goes, I could never forget you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu—
choice_data_list: ははっ

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Comedy hour was over with the last 
bit. Please don't put it in the past 
tense.
choice_data_list: ………………君は、本当に強く咲いたね
………………貴方は、本当に強く咲いたね

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I'm going to bloom even more 
brilliantly."
choice_data_list: Ah, that's right...!
Yeah, that's right...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off.
choice_data_list: ああ、そうだった……！
うん、そうだった……！

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes. Please look forward to it!
choice_data_list: 花形になるのを、見届けるよ
choice_data_list_en: I'll be there to see you become the star.

heart."

resolutely, continues to hone yourself in 
pursuit of greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye

No matter what happens, remaining 
dignified and unchanged, continuing to 
exist as the "Queen"—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will defeat you— the one who is 
always so wonderful and cool!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...You're praising me way too much. I've 
never even beaten you before, Ai-san."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And yet, here we are right now, facing 
each other.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
She's looking straight at me, as if 
saying, 'I'm going to win today'...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That reason alone is more than enough for 
why I want to win!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That's so like Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Come now, it's about time to get going, 
Lala!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Today, I am going to――――WIN!!!

text_block_list.text: ......I accept your direct challenge.

text_block_list.text:

an unlucky Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:

dazzling, it'll surely be talked about for 
generations to come.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:

exact opposite.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac

mean, it's true, right?)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac

greatest light in history can never 
outshine.)
